title: Migrate session coordination source root
summary: Move session focus, task-session links, artifact-status claims, worktree-isolation metadata, and related tool execution into src/session/**.

goal.outcome: Session coordination and artifact-status ownership live under src/session/** while codewiki_session/codewiki_artifact_status behavior and isolation policy remain unchanged.
acceptance: Create src/session/** owner modules for session types, task-session link normalization, focus/update use cases, artifact-status claim file logic, worktree-isolation helpers, and codewiki_session/codewiki_artifact_status tool execution.
Update adapters, schemas, compaction/session callers, tests, and package smoke to import session behavior from src/session/** or stable public API paths.
Remove old session/claims/worktree owner paths or retain only explicit temporary shims with TASK-specific tests.

Preserve codewiki_session and codewiki_artifact_status schemas/results, claim conflict/wait semantics, TTL/heartbeat/release behavior, worktree-isolation policy, package loading, and direct Node execution.
Add TASK-specific guard proving legacy session/claims/worktree imports are gone or explicitly shimmed.
non_goals: Do not migrate project, knowledge, roadmap/task queue, state/graph/resume, GC, change/diff-table, adapters/UI, or skills beyond session consumer import updates.
Do not change runtime session storage format, artifact-status JSON schema, isolation policy, or public tool behavior.
